note: Security office, 04:15. Raymond's end of the radio call, then Danny comes in.

entries.text: Webb, Okafor. Come in, over.
[RADIO CHIRP]
Yeah, Ray, I'm here. Go ahead.
Status on the system. Over.
It's a mess. The box is down hard. Video's toast, user logs wiped. Classic.
Say again? Wiped? Over.
Wiped. Badge-to-name tables, gone. All I've got is the emergency console.
Copy. I'm in the security office. Door panels still show lockdown. Over.
Yeah, that's not me. Lockdown's on a separate loop.
Understood. Okafor out.
[RADIO CHIRP]
Where is Kowalski.
[DOOR BUZZER]
Ray! Dude, it's like an oven out there.
You're late. Report.
Yeah, yeah. Checked the doors. Front entrance won't budge. No way anyone's getting out.
Anyone moving around without a badge?
Nah. Just us, the eggheads, and the cleaners. Bev's got coffee on.
Stay by your radio.
It's fine, it's fine. I'm not going anywhere. Literally.
[CHAIR CREAKS]

note: Server room, 04:15. Marcus's end of the same radio call.

entries.text: [SERVER FANS]
Webb, Okafor. Come in, over.
Yeah, Ray, I'm here. Go ahead.
Status on the system. Over.
It's a mess. The box is down hard. Video's toast, user logs wiped. Classic.
Say again? Wiped? Over.
Wiped. Badge-to-name tables, gone. All I've got is the emergency console.
Copy. I'm in the security office. Door panels still show lockdown. Over.
Yeah, that's not me. Lockdown's on a separate loop.
Understood. Okafor out.
"Okafor out." Love that guy.
Okay, box. Talk to me. Why don't I remember rebooting you?
[KEYBOARD TYPING]
Have you tried turning it off and on again? ...Apparently I did.

note: Kitchen, 04:30. The cleaners on a coffee break.

entries.text: [COFFEE MACHINE BEEPING]
There we go, love. Fresh pot. Best thing in this whole kitchen, that machine.
Mm.
Is it me or is it boiling in here? Half past four in the morning and I'm melting.
Air's off. Since the clunk.
Don't tell anyone I told you, but Gus has been swearing at that air system all night.
Not my business.
Ray was on the radio before, sounded right put out, sweetheart.
I saw Danny. He was late.
That boy. Pour him a cup, pet, he'll need it.
[CUPBOARD DOOR]
He's in security.
Then I'll take it over to him.

note: Offices, 03:15. The director on the phone.

entries.text: Yes. Yes, I understand.
Let's not get ahead of ourselves. The situation is contained.
No, the item is secure. I've been assured of that.
[PHONE STATIC]
Sorry, you're breaking up. The lockdown is still active, yes.
I'll handle it. I'm in my office, I can call you back on this line.
It's twenty-five past three. I'll call again at four.
[PHONE HANGS UP]
That's above your clearance, Richard. Above everyone's.
